# noderings_game_servers (Data Source)

Lists the organization's game servers, newest first, optionally filtered.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "noderings_game_servers" "ready" {
  phase = "ready"
}

output "ready_servers" {
  value = data.noderings_game_servers.ready.game_servers[*].name
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `name` (String) Only servers with this exact name.
- `phase` (String) Only servers in this phase: `pending`, `ready`, `error` or `failed`.
- `template_id` (String) Only servers running this game.

### Read-Only

- `game_servers` (Attributes List) The matching servers. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--game_servers))
- `ids` (List of String) IDs of the matching servers.

<a id="nestedatt--game_servers"></a>
